karen.chen: Heads up — int8 bringup for 'qiyu-v1' on staging shows a weird regression for Traditional Chinese (Hant) in the Taiwan locale. BLEU for news translation dropped ~6 points vs fp16.
hiro.tanaka: ugh. can you paste the failing example?
karen.chen: sure. minimal repro: input: "今年2025年的預算是 3,000 元。"  fp16 -> "今年 2025 年的預算是 3,000 元。"  int8 -> "今年2025年的預算是3,000元。"  (spaces around numerals/units removed)
sam.oks: that's subtle — looks like tokenization/segmentation changes after quantized kernels. any diff on token ids?
anya.eval: ran token-level diff on the batch. summary: fp16 tokens: ["今年", " 2025 年", "的", "預算", "是", " 3,000 元", "。"]  int8 tokens: ["今年2025年的", "預算是3,000元", "。"]
hiro.tanaka: whoa that's a big change — token merging. probably the SentencePiece model behaved differently due to decoding sampling or KV cache alignment. did you run with the exact same tokenizer binary?
karen.chen: yes same tokenizer artifact sha. I suspect a detokenization postprocess step got skipped in the int8 path (we have a 'space_fallback' heuristic that runs only for >512 ctx maybe?).
eval-bot: automated eval run 1758642150: BLEU_fp16=28.7  BLEU_int8=22.4  RougeL_fp16=0.48  RougeL_int8=0.41  mean_length_fp16=18.3  mean_length_int8=17.1
sam.oks: can you dump generation params? topk/temperature/penalty identical?
karen.chen: yes — params: topk=0 top_p=0.95 temp=0.0 repetition_penalty=1.0 max_new_tokens=128. Also ran deterministic sampling (temp=0) to avoid sampling variance.
anya.eval: I also tried toggling the 'legacy-detok' flag in the serving runtime. With legacy-detok=true int8 BLEU improved to 26.8 (still behind). Suggests both tokenizer and detok path changes.
hiro.tanaka: do we have a recent kernel switch in the int8 codepath? maybe a merged stride kernel that modifies token boundaries due to BytePair boundary scoring?
sam.oks: check the kernel selection log: in /var/log/redwood/inference/kernels.log for that deploy. ksel shows qk_matmul_v2_int8 used instead of qk_matmul_v1_fp16.
karen.chen: attaching a quick diff of tokens for a few samples (pasted):
```
# sample 1
input: 今年2025年的預算是 3,000 元。
fp16 tokens: 今年 | 2025 | 年 | 的 | 預算 | 是 | 3 , 000 | 元 | 。
int8 tokens: 今年2025年的預算是 | 3 , 000 | 元 | 。
```
anya.eval: thanks. my hypothesis: quantization-induced logits rounding compresses subword boundaries causing greedy decode to prefer a merged token. Combined with a detok rule that strips intra-word spaces for tokens classified as numeric-unit pairs.
hiro.tanaka: action items: (1) reproduce locally with the same quantized weights and single-threaded server; (2) run tokenization-only pass (no model) to confirm tokenizer unchanged; (3) run beam search decode vs greedy to see if merge is search-sensitive; (4) add targeted eval set for Hant numeric spacing.
sam.oks: I'll take (1) and (3). spinning up a local int8 runtime now. ETA ~30m.
karen.chen: I'll do (2) and craft a 200-sentence Taiwan Hant numeric/measurement suite for the eval infra. adding examples with mixed latin and han, dates, currency, ordinals.
anya.eval: I'll wire the new suite into the nightly regression job and set an alert if BLEU delta > 3 for any locale.
hiro.tanaka: if reproduces, we may need a small detok patch: keep space preservation for span types matching regex (han+\s*\d+|\d+\s*元|\d{4}年). let's not hardcode, add locale-aware heuristics.
karen.chen: noted. will prototype and open a PR.
eval-bot: note: created issue REDWOOD-ML-1279 referencing this thread.
sam.oks: nice. :thumbsup:
karen.chen: thanks — will update here after local repro.
